executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_multidim_treasury_cash_revision_cause_score_v1'
assert not out.exists(),'E12已有，不覆盖注册。'
out.mkdir()
parent=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1'
proposal=json.loads((parent/'next_experiment.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert proposal['status']=='PROPOSED_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN'
stamp=datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
protocol={'study_id':'510300_MULTIDIM_TREASURY_CASH_REVISION_CAUSE_SCORE_V1','experiment_id':'E12','registered_at':stamp,
    'phase':'SOURCE_FIRST_SEPARATE_MODEL_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED',
    'previous_goal_turn_classification':'PROGRESS_E11_ALL_FIXED_QUARTERS_CAUSE_PANEL_WITH_SOURCE_LIMITS',
    'question':'全部16原公告能否直接重建现金安排贡献与扣现金后借款修订两观察渠道，再检验其与原国内状态的非线性增量？',
    'source_scope':{'fixed_current_quarters':[str(y)+'Q'+str(q) for y in range(2022,2026) for q in range(1,5)],
        'boundary':'2021Q4前次原计划','reused_primary_htmls':17,'new_downloads':0,
        'fields_from':'相邻前次原公告中的本季借款/期末目标/前季期末目标，以及当前原公告本季借款/期末目标/前季实际现金/明确报告借款修订。',
        'not_used_as_missing_field_backfill':'不使用较晚PDF补较早字段，不读取E11缺失Financing Need/All Other Sources。',
        'actual_body_dates':'使用公告正文日期，原表旧日期标签不进入这个两渠道口径。'},
    'fields':['美国借款修订现金贡献','美国扣现金后借款修订'],
    'definitions':{'美国借款修订现金贡献':'(前次对起始现金的假设−当前原文已知实际起始现金)+(此次期末现金目标−前次期末目标)，十亿美元。',
        '美国扣现金后借款修订':'当前原公告明确报告借款修订−现金贡献，十亿美元；包含融资需要/其他融资/显示精度差，不称纯预算需要、纯流动性或市场共识意外。'},
    'source_gate':'全部固定16季度的两渠道所需直接原公告字段和实际正文日齐全；来源哈希与E11回执对应、同季度前次/此次值相符。缺一关键字段即NOT_RUN；原报告修订与显示金额相减差不强制消除。',
    'availability':'实际America/New_York正文公布日23:59:59转上海的保守上界；历史首版及当年收件未认证。仅在原决定前已知时使用。',
    'quarter_roots':'只有16个美国公布根；状态复用到国内月事件不增加独立根，后续必须保存每条源与年龄。',
    'new_question_boundary':'从四个独立分量的来源问题转为两条可直接观察合并渠道；不是把扣现金余项冒充E11缺字段。E11完整源门失败和E6/E9已失败模型保留。',
    'source_fields_already_seen_in_E11':True,'historical_independent_validation':False,
    'model_registration_required_after_source_gate':True,'equity_labels_allowed_in_source_phase':False,
    'new_source_code_files':0,'parameter_searches':0,'orders_authorized':False,
    'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','goal_achieved':False}
p=out/'protocol.json';p.write_text(json.dumps(protocol,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
inputs=['reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1/next_experiment.json',
    'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1/result.json',
    'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1/原公告字段及原因记录.json',
    'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1/release_receipts.json',
    'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1/actual_release_metadata.json']
freeze={'registered_at':stamp,'before_E12_source_extraction_or_equity_labels':True,
    'source_fields_already_observed_before_registration':True,
    'protocol_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    'input_hashes':{rel:hashlib.sha256((root/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for rel in inputs},
    'mandate_snapshot':json.loads((root/'config/510300_existing_data_training_mandate_v1.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8')),
    'historical_scope_snapshot':json.loads((root/'config/510300_historical_cause_discovery_v1.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))}
(out/'freeze.json').write_text(json.dumps(freeze,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print('E12两观察渠道来源口径已登记；只复用原17公告、不读股票标签，E11完整门失败保留。')
